utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s Thursday at the community center—if you want, I can send you the exact details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, that’d be great. I’ll also send a quick reminder to everyone and help pick the next book.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Perfect—I'll send the exact details now, and we can pick the next book together at the meetup.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, next week’s novel is picked, isn’t it? I’ll ask you for the title after my errands so we can get it settled ahead of time.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yep, we’ve got a new novel picked for next week. I’ll pass the title along when I get back, and Jules can send the meeting details too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Ira — I’ll ask you after errands so we can have it settled before Eli starts fretting. And if Vik keeps everyone posted, that should help too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks — I’m coming to the community center, so I’ll look for the little room by the library desk. Tea and pastries sound lovely too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, I’ll meet you there. And please thank Gus and Cleo for me—Cleo’s mystery picks are always such a treat.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Will do — I’ll pass that along to Gus and Cleo. See you at the community center!

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m planning to come too. I’ll watch for Quinn’s message and Rosa can send the details if needed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I’ll bring my notes and probably show up a bit late as usual. The Night Circus should be a good one.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thursday at the cafe works for me. I’ll see you there.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still planning to come by the community center on Maple, in the little room by the library desk. If anything changes, I’ll wait for Sam’s reminder.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so the place is the little room by the library desk at the community center on Maple — is the time confirmed too?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I haven’t heard a change, so I’m still assuming the usual time for now. If Faye confirms anything different, I’ll go with that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can check with the group on what we’re reading next, or help nail down a meeting time if that’s easier.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, I’m just waiting on Rosa to text the next pick. Once that comes through, Jules can send the details and save me a spot.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll wait on Rosa’s pick and can help lock in the meeting time once Jules sends the details.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: The book club meets at the community center, right? If you need an extra copy of the mystery read, Cleo said she can lend one.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yes, that’s right — the community center. And thanks, I’ll make sure Pia gets the book club details too.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Great, thanks. If the club needs anything else, Gus said he can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll ask Gus to help set the time and bring a few book ideas.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Great — and just to confirm, the book club is Thursday at the community center. I’m keeping the location noted down in case anyone asks.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks. I’ll keep Thursday at the community center in mind and let the others know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the time and exact address, but if Kira or Quinn sends it over, I’ll try to make it. Is it still at the community center on Maple, by the library desk?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: It’s actually Thursday at the cafe, not the community center—I can send you the details, and I’ll make sure Nell gets a spot too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, thanks for correcting me — I’d better have the exact details before I plan anything. Please send the time and address when you can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll mention the book club plans to everyone, and if Noah can make it, I’m sure he’ll have his usual good questions. Gus said he can help if we need anything, and Uli might listen in too.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — if I can make it, I’ll bring my usual questions. Just let me know if anything’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep everyone posted on the book club plans and let you know if we need anything.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: The Midnight Library is still my top pick, but I’m open to other suggestions. Can you bring the snacks and paper for the book club?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, I can bring the snacks and paper. I’m still reading a mystery this month, so I’ll be ready for book club.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks — could you also bring a little extra snacks and paper just in case? Hana’s still double-checking the suggestions, and I’m leaning toward The Midnight Library unless someone sways me.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Mina seems to be leaning toward "The Midnight Library," and Mara is bringing a few suggestions too. If you want, I can help check the details for the book club.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, great — I’ll pass along Mara’s ideas when I hear them. And yes, the book club’s at the community center, with tea and pastries, so it should be lovely.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds lovely — I’ll keep that in mind and check any details before we finalize anything.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll mention the book club plans to everyone, and if we need anything, Gus said he’d help. Uli might listen in too, so I’ll keep it friendly and open.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good—Gus can help lock in the time and bring a few book ideas. I’ll keep it short and practical.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll tell everyone the time and a few book ideas, and keep it short so it’s easy for Uli to follow along too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the new novel for next week — I’ll catch up on it before then. And Vik said he’d keep everyone posted, so we should have the plan settled soon.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for the final plan. If it’s The Night Circus or The Midnight Library, I’m ready.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great — thanks, Noah. I’ll read up on it and wait for Vik’s update so we can lock things in.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thursday at the community center works for me — I’m just waiting on Rosa to text the next pick.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great — I’ll help pick the next book, send everyone a quick reminder, and make sure Tess gets Faye’s thanks.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect — just ping me when Rosa texts the next pick, and I’ll be there Thursday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m leaning toward "The Midnight Library" too, but I’d like to hear Mara’s suggestions before we decide. Gus can help with anything we still need, and Dane can bring his notes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — Mara can bring a few suggestions next meetup, and then I can send you the exact Thursday details for the community center book club.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That sounds perfect — I’ll wait for Mara’s suggestions before we pick, and then I can share the Thursday details with everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh good, I heard it’s at the community center with tea and pastries. I’m coming, so if there’s a spot saved for me, that’d be lovely.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: You’re all set — Rosa saved you a spot and has the details. It’s at the community center, and Gus can help if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, perfect — thanks for letting me know. I’ll head to the community center and look for Rosa if I need anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’ll probably be a little late, as usual, but I can still make it. The Night Circus should give us plenty to talk about.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thursday at the community center still stands, so you should be good even if you’re a bit late. And yes, The Night Circus should spark a lively discussion.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Perfect, I’ll head over as soon as I can. If Cleo brings the snacks and paper, we’ll be all set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m bringing extra snacks and paper for book club, and I read a mystery this month. Dane might be a bit late, but he’ll bring his notes.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Cleo. I’m still planning to come to the community center on Maple, in the little room by the library desk.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll see you there at the community center on Maple. I’ll keep the snacks and paper ready for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can bring over a few good book ideas, or I can help nail down a meeting time for the club.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Gus — a few book ideas would really help. We’re still meeting at the community center, so we can sort it out there.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll swing by with a few solid book ideas. Then we can nail down the meeting time at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Rosa — send me the details when you can. I’m planning to come too.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — it’s Thursday at the cafe, and I’ll send you the details too.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Perfect, thank you. I’ll watch for Quinn’s message too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m leaning toward The Midnight Library, but I’m open if the group has a stronger pick. Could you let me know what everyone decides?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can pass that along, but I still need the exact time and the room details before I can be sure I make it. Once Quinn sends them, I’ll let you know what the group decides.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Pia. Just send me the time and room when Quinn has them, and I’ll wait for the group’s decision.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: We’re at the community center tonight, and I can save you a seat by the window if you want. There’ll be tea and pastries too.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: That sounds fine, but can you confirm the exact time? I’ll let Pia know once I’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll check the exact time and let you know as soon as I have it. I’ll also pass along Mara’s book suggestions when I hear them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh nice — I heard the book club picked a new novel for next week. Jules can send over the meeting details, and Mara’s bringing a few suggestions for the next meetup.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, that should help everyone stay on the same page. I’m glad Jules can send the details—I’ll make sure I’m set for next week.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that should make next week easy to follow. I’ll keep an ear out if anything changes.
